findings: `atob` exception leaves partial directory — `atob(b64)` for PNG byte conversion in `saveProjectToDirectory` has no try/catch. A corrupt texture data URL throws DOMException, propagates to `handleSave`'s `.catch()` alert, but partial directory contents are not cleaned up. Wrap the `atob` and `Uint8Array.from` call in a try/catch; either skip the PNG write and log a warning, or surface a typed error before any directory writes begin.

ResizeHandle not keyboard-operable — `role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical"` without an `onKeyDown` handler means keyboard users cannot resize the panel. Add `onKeyDown` with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight incrementing/decrementing `jsonPanelWidth` by a fixed step (e.g., 20px), clamped to the same 200px–50vw bounds.
